reasons.plausibility: It leverages established ab initio methods and known phonon-electron physics in high-entropy alloys, making the separate modeling of lattice and electronic transport scientifically credible.
reasons.testability: The proposed falsification experiment (resolving lattice and electronic contributions under controlled oxygen levels) is sufficiently specific and feasible to conclusively test the model’s accuracy claims.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a key gap (decoupling transport mechanisms) and provides a concrete predictive improvement, making it highly valuable for guiding future experimental and theoretical work on high-entropy alloy thermal properties.
